_comment: DOOM-0312: source_roots is linuxdoom-1.10 alone, deliberately. ipx/, sersrc/ and sndserv/ are DOS-era helpers kept as historical reference per DOOM-0085 and built by nothing, but the static-analysis sweeps parsed them and reported findings that are real about the code and irrelevant to the product. Those findings are recorded and closed on DOOM-0414, unfixed. If any of these trees becomes a build target again, add it back here and reopen DOOM-0414 first.
